content: You label the main emotion a writer expresses in a short text. Choose the one emotion that dominates (joy, anger, sadness, fear), or none when none does. Answer with a JSON object with the keys emotion, intensity (1 to 5) and reason (one sentence), and nothing else.

Which emotion dominates this text, how strong is it, and why?

I finally got the job. I can't stop smiling.
{"emotion": "joy", "intensity": 5, "reason": "The writer reports getting the job and smiling uncontrollably."}

Which emotion dominates this text, how strong is it, and why?

The meeting is at 3. Bring the printed copies.
{"emotion": "none", "intensity": 1, "reason": "The text only states a time and an instruction."}
